meanings.en: a small amount or to a small degree
meanings.exampleEn: I'm a bit tired after the long trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yolculuktan sonra biraz yorgunum.

meanings.en: two, or a small number of, things or people
meanings.exampleEn: I'll be ready in a couple of minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç dakika içinde hazır olurum.

meanings.en: a small number of people or things
meanings.exampleEn: There are a few apples left in the basket.
meanings.exampleTr: Sepette birkaç elma kaldı.

meanings.en: a large amount or number; very much
meanings.exampleEn: She spends a lot of money on clothes.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıyafetlere çok para harcıyor.

meanings.en: the act of leaving someone or something completely, or of giving something up
meanings.exampleEn: The child suffered from a deep fear of abandonment.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk derin bir terk edilme korkusu yaşadı.

meanings.en: the giving up of a plan, right, or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The abandonment of the project cost the company millions.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeden vazgeçilmesi şirkete milyonlara mal oldu.

meanings.en: to make a word or phrase shorter by leaving out letters or using only the first letters
meanings.exampleEn: You can abbreviate "Doctor" to "Dr."
meanings.exampleTr: "Doctor" kelimesini "Dr." olarak kısaltabilirsin.

meanings.en: the part of the body between the chest and the legs containing the stomach and other organs
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen.
meanings.exampleTr: Karnında keskin bir ağrı hissetti.

meanings.en: a person who takes someone away illegally by force or deception
meanings.exampleEn: The police finally caught the abductor after a long search.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis uzun bir aramadan sonra sonunda kaçıranı yakaladı.

meanings.en: a temporary change from what is normal or expected, usually one that is not good
meanings.exampleEn: The sudden drop in sales was just a temporary aberration.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlardaki ani düşüş sadece geçici bir sapmaydı.

meanings.en: to hate a way of behaving or thinking, often because you think it is morally wrong
meanings.exampleEn: I abhor all forms of cruelty to animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvanlara yapılan her türlü zulümden nefret ederim.

meanings.en: a feature or condition that is not normal, especially one that causes illness or harm
meanings.exampleEn: The scan revealed an abnormality in the patient's heart.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarama, hastanın kalbinde bir anormallik olduğunu ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: the place where someone lives
meanings.exampleEn: Welcome to my humble abode.
meanings.exampleTr: Mütevazı meskenime hoş geldin.

meanings.en: the act of ending an activity or custom officially
meanings.exampleEn: The abolition of slavery was a major turning point in history.
meanings.exampleTr: Köleliğin kaldırılması tarihte önemli bir dönüm noktasıydı.

meanings.en: located on or above the surface of the ground
meanings.exampleEn: They installed an aboveground swimming pool in the backyard.
meanings.exampleTr: Arka bahçeye yer üstü havuzu kurdular.

meanings.en: to make a book, play, or other piece of writing shorter
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to abridge the novel for younger readers.
meanings.exampleTr: Romanı genç okuyucular için kısaltmaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: the fact of being frequently away from work or school, especially without a good reason
meanings.exampleEn: High absenteeism among staff is costing the company money.
meanings.exampleTr: Personel arasındaki yüksek devamsızlık şirkete para kaybettiriyor.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you are thinking about something else and not paying attention
meanings.exampleEn: She absentmindedly stirred her coffee while staring out the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Pencereden dışarı bakarken dalgın dalgın kahvesini karıştırdı.

meanings.en: the process of taking in a liquid, gas, or other substance
meanings.exampleEn: The absorption of water by the roots keeps the plant alive.
meanings.exampleTr: Suyun kökler tarafından emilmesi bitkiyi canlı tutar.

meanings.en: the state of being completely interested in something
meanings.exampleEn: Her absorption in the book was so deep she didn't hear the doorbell.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitaba öyle dalmıştı ki kapı zilini duymadı.

meanings.en: to not do something, especially something enjoyable that you think might be bad
meanings.exampleEn: He decided to abstain from alcohol during the training season.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenman döneminde alkolden uzak durmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: to choose not to vote
meanings.exampleEn: Three members voted in favour and two abstained.
meanings.exampleTr: Üç üye lehte oy kullandı, ikisi çekimser kaldı.

meanings.en: not allowing yourself to have much food or many enjoyable things, especially alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: He led an abstemious life, eating little and drinking no alcohol.
meanings.exampleTr: Az yiyerek ve alkol içmeyerek ölçülü bir hayat sürdü.

meanings.en: the practice of not doing or having something that is enjoyable but possibly harmful
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor recommended total abstinence from alcohol.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor alkolden tamamen uzak durmayı önerdi.

meanings.en: choosing not to do or have something enjoyable, especially food, alcohol, or sex
meanings.exampleEn: He has remained abstinent from alcohol for over ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: On yıldan fazla süredir alkolden uzak durdu.

meanings.en: a very deep hole that seems to have no bottom
meanings.exampleEn: They stood at the edge of the abyss, looking down into darkness.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçurumun kenarında durup karanlığa baktılar.

meanings.en: a difficult situation that brings trouble or destruction
meanings.exampleEn: The country was sliding into an economic abyss.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke ekonomik bir uçuruma doğru kayıyordu.

meanings.en: in a way that is good enough or satisfactory
meanings.exampleEn: The team performed acceptably, though not brilliantly.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım parlak olmasa da kabul edilebilir bir performans gösterdi.

meanings.en: public approval and praise
meanings.exampleEn: The film received widespread critical acclaim.
meanings.exampleTr: Film geniş çapta eleştirmen övgüsü aldı.

meanings.en: to praise someone or something publicly
meanings.exampleEn: Critics acclaimed the novel as a masterpiece.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler romanı bir başyapıt olarak övdü.

meanings.en: praised by a lot of people
meanings.exampleEn: She is an internationally acclaimed pianist.
meanings.exampleTr: O, uluslararası alanda beğenilen bir piyanisttir.

meanings.en: to become used to a new place, situation, or climate
meanings.exampleEn: It took the climbers a week to acclimatize to the high altitude.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcıların yüksek irtifaya alışması bir hafta sürdü.

meanings.en: officially recognized or approved as meeting a required standard
meanings.exampleEn: The course is offered by an accredited university.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurs, akredite bir üniversite tarafından sunulmaktadır.

meanings.en: an amount of something that has been collected or has gathered over time
meanings.exampleEn: Years of accumulation had filled the attic with junk.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren birikme, tavan arasını eski eşyalarla doldurmuştu.

meanings.en: a device or thing that collects or stores something, such as energy or numbers
meanings.exampleEn: The solar panels feed energy into an accumulator for later use.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş panelleri, daha sonra kullanılmak üzere enerjiyi bir akümülatöre aktarır.

meanings.en: someone who is successful, especially because they work hard
meanings.exampleEn: She has always been a high achiever at school and work.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulda ve işte her zaman çok başarılı biri olmuştur.

meanings.en: an official decision in a court of law that a person is not guilty of a crime
meanings.exampleEn: The jury's acquittal surprised everyone in the courtroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Jürinin beraat kararı mahkeme salonundaki herkesi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: to behave badly or in a way that causes problems
meanings.exampleEn: The children always act up when they're tired.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar yorgun olduklarında hep yaramazlık yapar.

meanings.en: to fail to work or function properly
meanings.exampleEn: My knee has been acting up since the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Dizim kazadan beri ağrıyıp sorun çıkarıyor.

meanings.en: clothing designed to be worn for sports or exercise
meanings.exampleEn: The brand is expanding its range of activewear for women.
meanings.exampleTr: Marka, kadınlar için spor giyim yelpazesini genişletiyor.

meanings.en: a person who works to bring about political or social change
meanings.exampleEn: She is a well-known environmental activist.
meanings.exampleTr: O, tanınmış bir çevre aktivistidir.

meanings.en: to speak or perform without preparing what you are going to say
meanings.exampleEn: When he forgot his lines, he had to ad-lib.
meanings.exampleTr: Repliklerini unutunca doğaçlama yapmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: causing a strong need or desire that is hard to stop
meanings.exampleEn: Nicotine is a highly addictive substance.
meanings.exampleTr: Nikotin oldukça bağımlılık yapan bir maddedir.

meanings.en: the fact of behaving according to a particular rule, belief, or standard
meanings.exampleEn: Strict adherence to the safety rules is essential.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenlik kurallarına sıkı sıkıya uyulması şarttır.

meanings.en: next to or joined with something
meanings.exampleEn: They booked two adjoining rooms at the hotel.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelde birbirine bitişik iki oda ayırttılar.

meanings.tr: hüküm vermek, karar vermek, hakemlik yapmak
meanings.en: to make an official decision about who is right in a disagreement
meanings.exampleEn: An independent panel will adjudicate the dispute.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağımsız bir kurul anlaşmazlık hakkında karar verecek.

meanings.en: someone whose job is to manage or organize a business, organization, or system
meanings.exampleEn: The system administrator reset all the passwords.
meanings.exampleTr: Sistem yöneticisi tüm parolaları sıfırladı.

meanings.en: acceptable or allowed, especially in a court of law
meanings.exampleEn: The judge ruled that the evidence was not admissible.
meanings.exampleTr: Hâkim, delilin kabul edilemez olduğuna hükmetti.

meanings.en: to tell someone firmly that you disapprove of what they have done
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher admonished the students for being late.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen, geç kaldıkları için öğrencileri azarladı.

meanings.en: a feeling of great love, respect, or worship
meanings.exampleEn: She gazed at the baby with pure adoration.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeğe saf bir hayranlıkla baktı.

meanings.en: made lower in quality by adding something of poorer quality
meanings.exampleEn: The company was fined for selling adulterated food.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, hile karıştırılmış gıda sattığı için para cezasına çarptırıldı.
